"after last round promissory isn't redeemed" — so round 6 promissory paid in round... promissory added to cash at start of round. Round 6 start promissory added to cash, then round 7 doesn't exist — but does cash devalue after final round? "start of round 2 and onwards: cash=floor(cash/100)*62, then promissory added" — round 6 start applies. So promissory is better: avoids devaluation of round 5 cash... actually devaluation happens at round 6 start on existing cash; promissory added after. So sell_credit gives 1.25x and avoids round-6 devaluation. Best: sell all 3 credit.
